problems.problem: Contact shadow under the bottle is fainter and tighter than the shadows and melt-water pools of the neighbouring ice cubes, so the packshot reads slightly set-down rather than settled into the marble plane.
problems.evidence: Ice cubes at far left and bottom right cast soft graded shadows with wet halos; the bottle base at y≈960 shows only a thin dark line with minimal spread on the bright marble.
problems.repair: Strengthen and slightly widen the contact shadow (raise opacity toward 0.5, blur 12-16) and add a faint cool reflection smear under the base to match the cubes' grounding.

problems.problem: Unplanned distracting prop: a small glass tumbler with amber residue sits on the counter beside the bottle, competing with the hero product in a beverage ad.
problems.evidence: Clear tumbler at approximately (730,860) on the ivory countertop, right of the bottle base; no such object exists in the approved background spec.
problems.repair: Remove the tumbler or replace it with empty counter space; keep the counter clear so the bottle owns the scene.

problems.problem: Grounding is weak: the bottle base sits almost on the chrome front-edge band of the counter with only a hairline shadow, so the contact reads pasted rather than weight-bearing.
problems.evidence: Base at y≈945 lands within a few pixels of the metallic edge trim at y≈950-975; no cast shadow gradient extends across the laminate toward the viewer.
problems.repair: Move the bottle 40-60 px up-counter (deeper into the laminate plane) and add a soft frontal cast shadow consistent with the diffuse diner light.

problems.problem: The right-hand subtitle floats in empty wall space with no anchor to either the title block or the bottle, leaving a visual hole in the centre-right of the composition.
problems.evidence: Subtitle block at (470,466)-(653,491) sits isolated against blank wall, far from the title at top left and from the bottle at centre-left; the eye has no path between them.
problems.repair: Align the subtitle under the title block or shift it down beside the bottle shoulder so it forms a diagonal reading line with the product.

reason: Motion is the only study with zero defects: the flat graphic satin field is an intentional non-photographic presentation, so no floor contact is required, and the bottle reads as a deliberately floating brand object with clean edges, intact label, cap and white-baked neck transmission exactly as sourced. Typography (停一下。/ 让此刻，有滋有味。/ lockup line) is crisp, correctly lettered and well hierarchical against the deep red field; composition balances the white type block against the centred bottle; brand tone is confident and premium. Ice and sculpture are close but each carries one repairable grounding or anchoring flaw, and diner fails on an unplanned tumbler prop plus edge-of-counter contact, so motion wins on coherence and craft.
